key.name: mode
key.description: Floating pill, or integrated into the panel's clock area.

key.name: minimal
key.description: Collapse the closed notch to a thin line.

key.name: size-scale
key.description: Manual size multiplier applied on top of the wide-monitor auto scale.

key.name: language
key.description: Interface language; 'auto' follows the daemon's locale.

key.name: mascot
key.description: Use the always-animated eyes as the notch's resting face instead of the clock.

key.name: greeting-enabled
key.description: Show a personal greeting with the mascot eyes at the greeting time.

key.name: greeting-time
key.description: Local time (HH:MM) at which the daily morning greeting plays.

key.name: greeting-birthday
key.description: Your birthday as MM-DD. At the greeting time on this day, the eyes burst into confetti and say "La mulți ani". Empty disables it.

key.name: greeting-name
key.description: The name used in the daily greeting. Leave empty for a greeting without a name.

key.name: work-end-lead-minutes
key.summary: Minutes before end of work to give a heads-up

key.name: routine-weekdays-only
key.summary: Lunch and work greetings only Monday to Friday

key.name: routine-delivered
key.summary: Last local date and schedule delivered per routine

key.name: mascot-contextual
key.summary: React to music, focus and evening

key.name: motion-intensity
key.summary: Personality motion intensity; zero disables expressive movement

key.name: eye-style
key.description: Which mascot eye personality to loop: auto (random mix) or a fixed one.

key.name: greeting-preview
key.description: Toggled from preferences to preview the greeting immediately.

key.name: greeting-preview-birthday
key.description: Toggled from preferences to preview the birthday confetti greeting.

key.name: color-theme
key.description: Accent palette for the notch: default, midnight, neon, nord, dracula or sunset.

key.name: album-glow
key.description: Tint the notch halo and the progress bar with the dominant color of the current cover art.

key.name: mascot-groove
key.description: Let the eyes bob gently in time with the beat while music plays.

key.name: scroll-skip
key.summary: Scroll the closed notch to skip tracks
key.description: While music plays, scrolling over the closed notch skips to the next or previous track instead of changing pages.

key.name: weather-enabled
key.summary: Show weather on the summary page
key.description: Fetch the current weather from the free open-meteo service for the configured coordinates. No account or key is required.

key.name: hidden-pages
key.description: Comma-separated page names to hide from the tabs and navigation (e.g. "clipboard,search").
